tool.name: MS2Rescore
tool.description: rescore peptide-spectrum matches using predicted features
tool.command: export OMP_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" MKL_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" XDG_CACHE_HOME="\$PWD/.cache" && mkdir -p models spectra && #if $spectra.mode == 'single' ln -s '$spectra.spectrum' 'spectra/input.$spectra.spectrum.ext' && #elif $spectra.mode == 'multiple' python '$__tool_directory__/check_spectrum_names.py' '$spectrum_names' && #for $item in $spectra.runs ln -s '$item.spectrum' 'spectra/$item.run_name.$item.spectrum.ext' && #end for #end if ms2rescore --config-file ms2rescore.json --psm-file #for $psm_file in $psm_files '$psm_file' #end for --psm-file-type '$psm_file_type' --output-path result --processes "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --disable-update-check

param.name: psm_files
param.label: Peptide-spectrum matches
param.help: Include all target and decoy matches without FDR filtering. Multiple files should generally only be combined for LC-fractionated runs.

section.name: pin_reader
section.title: PIN reader settings
section.help: Used only for Percolator PIN input. Column names are case-insensitive.

param.name: score_column
param.label: Search engine score column
param.help: Required unless the PIN file has a column named score. For example, hyperscore or lnEValue.

param.name: retention_time_column
param.label: Retention time column
param.help: Leave empty if retention times will be read from spectra or are not needed.

param.name: mz_column
param.label: Precursor m/z column
param.help: Leave empty if precursor m/z will be read from spectra or is not needed.

param.name: mode
param.label: Spectrum input
param.option: Multiple spectrum files, matched by run name
No spectrum file (only features already available from the PSMs)

param.name: spectrum
param.label: Spectrum file
param.help: Spectra for a single MS run. Spectrum identifiers must match the identification file.

param.name: run_name
param.label: Run name
param.help: Exact run name from the PSM file, without the MGF/mzML extension. Names must be unique and cannot be prefixes of one another (for example, run1 and run10), because MS2Rescore uses prefix matching.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens; start with a letter or digit.

param.name: feature_generators
param.label: Feature generators
param.help: Basic features use search scores, charge, mass errors and peptide length. MS2PIP and MS2 spectrum features require spectra. DeepLC needs retention times, in the PSMs or spectrum files.

param.name: fragmentation_model
param.label: Spectrum annotation ion series
param.option: All (a, b, c, x, y, z)

param.name: calibration_fraction
param.label: Fraction of target PSMs used for DeepLC calibration

param.name: finetune
param.label: Fine-tune DeepLC on high-confidence targets
param.help: Requires enough targets at 1% FDR and increases runtime.

param.name: train_fdr
param.label: Training FDR
param.help: Fraction used to select training targets. Increase, for example to 0.1, if too few targets pass the default threshold.

param.name: max_psm_rank_input
param.label: Maximum input PSM rank per spectrum

param.name: report_fdr
param.label: Reporting FDR
param.help: Fraction used in the report and to filter FlashLFQ output. Main result tables remain unfiltered.

param.name: id_decoy_pattern
param.label: Decoy protein regular expression
param.help: Provide a pattern such as ^DECOY_ to enable picked-protein competition. If empty, input decoy labels are used and protein-level FDR uses a plain rollup.

param.name: psm_id_pattern
param.label: PSM spectrum identifier regular expression
param.help: Optional expression with exactly one capturing group, used to extract spectrum identifiers from the PSM file.

param.name: spectrum_id_pattern
param.label: Spectrum identifier regular expression
param.help: Optional expression with exactly one capturing group, used to extract spectrum identifiers from spectrum titles.

param.name: rename_to_usi
param.label: Convert spectrum identifiers to Universal Spectrum Identifiers

param.name: sites
param.label: Sites
param.help: Comma-separated residues or termini, for example C or N-term.

param.name: write_flashlfq
param.label: Export targets for FlashLFQ
param.help: Only targets passing the reporting FDR are exported.

tool.help:
MS2Rescore adds features from predicted fragmentation intensities (MS2PIP), predicted retention times (DeepLC), spectrum annotations and basic identification properties. Ristretto then rescores the matches and estimates false discovery rates using targets and decoys.
Provide **all target and decoy PSMs without FDR filtering** from a search performed with target-decoy competition. Choose the identification format explicitly. The TSV format is the PSM-utils/MS2Rescore format, not an arbitrary table. PIN files may also contain existing rescoring features; specify their search score column in the PIN reader settings unless it is named ``score``. Multiple identification files should generally only be combined for LC-fractionated runs, because merging unrelated runs can affect FDR control.
Provide the corresponding MGF or mzML spectra when using MS2PIP or MS2 spectrum features. For multiple spectrum files, supply every run in the PSMs and enter its exact run name, without file extensions. Run names must be unique and must not be prefixes of one another (for example, ``run1`` and ``run10``), because the upstream file lookup uses prefix matching. Ambiguous names are rejected before rescoring. Use the identifier regular expressions if PSM identifiers and spectrum titles use different conventions; each expression must contain exactly one capturing group. DeepLC requires retention times and enough target matches for calibration. When no spectra are provided, select features supported by data already present in the PSM file (for example, basic features only).
Prediction models can be downloaded by the upstream libraries when first needed, so prediction can require an internet connection. MS2PIP models are cached in the job directory. Select a model appropriate for the fragmentation method and labeling chemistry. Modification mappings translate search-engine labels to ProForma modifications; fixed modifications add modifications omitted from the identification file.
The main PSM output retains scores, q-values, posterior error probabilities and features in PSM-utils TSV format. The identification collection contains PSM, peptidoform and peptide tables, and a protein-group table when every PSM has protein assignments. These results contain targets and decoys and are **not FDR-filtered**. Only the best match per spectrum is retained after rescoring. The reporting FDR controls summary statistics and the optional FlashLFQ export of high-confidence targets; it does not filter the main results. The configuration, feature list, weights and log document the settings and feature usage. The optional HTML report provides interactive quality control plots.
See the `MS2Rescore documentation <https://ms2rescore.readthedocs.io/en/v4.0.2/>`_ for input formats, search-engine-specific notes and feature descriptions.
